dex.herobrine_ritual.title: HERODEX
dex.herobrine_ritual.intro: Your Herobrine collection. Catch every kind, level them up and give them jobs.
dex.herobrine_ritual.howto:
How to catch

Beat a Herobrine in a boss fight - yourself or with your Herobrines. On the final blow it joins you.

Wild ones appear on their own (see each page). A ritual summons the kind you choose (Lv 10).
dex.herobrine_ritual.staff_help:
Command Staff

Shift+RMB air: mode
RMB your Herobrine: select
RMB creature: attack
Duel: select, RMB another
Guard/Mine/Haul: click 2 corners of an area (hold the staff to see the grid)
Chest: storage
Shift+chest: source
